svg.data-mounting: 19 in., 21 in. and 23 in. racks with extra mounting equipment, vertical or horizontal
svg.data-power-input-dc: 48/60 V DC nominal; fully redundant power feeding (branch A and B)
svg.data-power-feed-limit: 80 A with two LPWR-F AA, 100 A with two LPWR-F AB
svg.data-power-wiring: three-wire as delivered; two-wire by bridging the six BATRET/FG fast-on pairs on the backpanel
svg.data-operating-temp: -40 C to +65 C at the air inlet of the shelf
svg.data-operating-temp-central-office: -5 C to 55 C (ETSI EN 300 019 Class 3.1E, GR-63-CORE)
svg.data-emc: ETS EN 300 386; ETS ES 201 468; GR-1089-CORE; ICES-003 issue 7 (2020); VCCI-CISPR32: 2016
svg.data-environmental-class: ETS EN 300 019-1-3 Class 3.1E and Class 3.3; GR-3108-CORE Class 1 and Class 2; GR-63-CORE for Temperature and Humidity
svg.data-rohs: EU Directive 2011/65/EU as amended including by Directive 2015/863/EU
